CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
May 22, 2018 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.

PROCLAMATION FOR OLDER AMERICANS MONTH – It is recommended the City Council proclaim May 2018 as Older Americans Month in the City of La Mirada and present a proclamation to Charlene Ricker.

RECOGNITION OF ESCALONA ELEMENTARY SCHOOL FOR RECEIVING THE 2018 CALIFORNIA DISTINGUISHED SCHOOLS AWARD - It is recommended the City Council present Principal Bonnie Lytle of Escalona Elementary School with a Certificate of Recognition for her school being recognized as a 2018 California Distinguished School.
6.2 Recognition of Escalona Elementary School

RECOGNITION OF LA MIRADA HIGH SCHOOL STUDENTS FOR ACADEMIC ACHIEVEMENTS - It is recommended the City Council recognize the top senior scholars at La Mirada High School for their outstanding academic achievements and present them with a Certificate of Recognition.

CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2017-06, PLAY AREA REHABILITATION AT GARDENHILL AND WINDERMERE PARKS â€“ REVIEW OF BIDS AND AWARD OF CONTRACT â€“ It is recommended the City Council award the contract for Capital Improvement Project No. 2017-06, Play Area Rehabilitation at Gardenhill and Windermere Parks, to R.E. Schultz Construction, Inc. in the amount of $771,594.01; authorize the City Manager to execute the contract on behalf of the City; authorize the City Manager to approve addendums to the existing on-call engineering contracts for construction support services in an amount up to ten percent of the total project cost; and authorize the City Manager to approve additional work up to 20 percent of the total project cost including construction and construction survey, testing and inspection.

AWARD OF CONTRACT TO WHITEWATER FOR THE DESIGN, PURCHASE AND DELIVERY OF A WATERPARK FEATURE - It is recommended the City Council approve the selection of Whitewater to provide design, manufacturing, and delivery of waterslide parts and components for the Splash! water slide feature project in the amount of $1,123,786; authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement on behalf of the City; and authorize the City Manager to approve additional work up to 15 percent of the project amount.
